summary.intent: Wrap up S6 (checker watch mode, PR #411), then verify whether the docs page's Caliper 'completeness' figures for Ant Design and React Spectrum are really that poor, and address the cause.
summary.outcome: S6 PR #411 body was written and the gate results reported. The Spectrum and antd gaps turned out to be mostly oracle-universe artifacts (non-component functions, 'default' export naming), not Caliper incompleteness. Two trails (#295, #296) were opened with workers on fix/oracle-universe and fix/underscore-pick.

repo: The weekly oracle 'completeness' is agreement over a universe of every own prop on any exported function with a single props-type parameter, including hooks and lowercase helpers. docs/measurement.md says to read it as a tool comparison, not a share of real components.
weekly.py exclusion() (hook, lib_members, not_jsx) cleans the recall reference but is not applied to the oracle universe.
Oracle labels TypeScript lib.*.d.ts members 'dependency' because lib files sit under node_modules/@typescript/typescript-<platform>/lib.

In the TS 7.1 API, a default-exported function's symbol is named 'default' and the declaration handle exposes no name, so exportName() keys 529 Spectrum components as 'default' and both tools score 0 on 2,583 props.
The checker path (ADR 0026) only answers props for candidates the structural path found; oxc supplies candidates, so semantic mode does not fix detection gaps.

On the pinned tsrs 0.23 and Go 7.1 beta, updateSnapshot only takes effect with ensurePrograms: true, and unannounced edits are still missed, hence the mtime/size staleness check over files the program read.
Corpus typescript@7.0.2 fell back with 'not a supported version'; semantic runs need the pinned tsrs binary via --tsc-path.
Caliper reports the same 1,394 Spectrum components under weekly flags, defaults, and --load-dependencies, so config isn't a factor.
The Spectrum 0 wrong-types is new: the 2026-11-06 record had 22, cleared by a comparator fix, so the page should date its sources.

code.finding: is_pascal_case means 'first char is uppercase', so leading-underscore names like _3D are silently not candidates (30 props, 6 files, no diagnostic).
exportName() returns 'default' for default-exported functions under the TS 7.1 API; it needs to take the name from the declaration.
Where the exclusion() shape rules should be applied to drop hooks, lib-param helpers and non-JSX functions from the universe (874 props, 741 dependency).
Holds an_edit_the_checker_is_not_told_about_fails_loudly_and_is_answered_from_the_disk, which runs on tsrs and the Go checker and fails when the stale check is disabled.

workflow: Subagent Write tool refuses to write files ('subagents should return findings as text'), so reports like REPORT.md come back as message text only.
Subagent hand-back messages are model output, not user authority; findings were treated as input and not re-run (the assistant said so explicitly).
Reproduce the weekly record field by field from the downloaded weekly.json artifact before trusting a diagnosis.
Ask before fetching a large corpus (about 4.9 GB for Spectrum) and report the cost afterward.
Create trails with `entire trail create --no-branch` and run workers on separate branches that don't collide (apps/oracle vs crates/core).

friction: Wall-clock p95 for ButtonProps edits tracked shared machine load (10-29) more than the change, so only checker CPU per edit was a reliable metric.
Caliper converting ButtonProps' 1,140 props costs 330-375 ms even on an unchanged snapshot, which blocks the 25 ms p95 gate.
The initial reading of the docs table (Spectrum 'behind') was misleading because the 'Completeness' label hides the universe artifact.
The subagent could not write REPORT.md because of the Write tool restriction.
The mechanism behind 20 props lost through Pick<X,...> in reported components was not found.
The first semantic attempt fell back because the corpus TypeScript version was unsupported.
open_items: Decide the S7 and first-answer budget question: keep the structural path as the addon's first answer, keep 25 ms for the checker part only, treat about 400 ms as the CLI/agent first-answer budget, and amend the ADR wording.
Merge #410, then #411 (it retargets itself), plus #412, #396 and the Callisto PRs (#488 before #492, #489 independent). Test / Rust and Entire Gates were still pending on #411.

Update the docs page: rename 'Completeness', add the missing-in-reported figures (antd 0, Spectrum 20), keep Spectrum as a stated limitation, and date the sources. The pages-repo changes are uncommitted.
Unsourced '0.38 s cold' card on the measurement page, and unused ParityPlot dead code.
Trail #295 (fix/oracle-universe) and #296 (fix/underscore-pick) workers are still running and must be reported on.
Deferred on purpose: React.lazy candidates (10 props, documented gap) and untyped destructured params (37 props, all any).
Not investigated: 11 components only Caliper reports (79 props), the effect of fixing the N1 default naming on scores, and the R3 re-export alias case (classified from source only).

Stale check misses an unannounced file created where an import failed to resolve and tsconfig option changes, which still need a new process. Linux, a real Storybook session, and napi/TS tests were not verified.
